provenance: INVENTED TEST DATA, not a recording. Hand-written for the Phase 0 fake Kraken client
(spec 15) and committed in afaf2f5 on 2026-09-08. It was never cut from any archive:
the recorder archives WebSocket v2 frames and AssetPairs is a REST call.
tests/harness/fake_kraken.py's own docstring calls every file in this directory
invented numbers for a fake exchange and says they would be replaced with genuine
redacted recordings in Phase 2; that replacement never happened.
So the ordermin, costmin, tick_size, lot_decimals and pair_decimals below are
values somebody in this project chose, not Kraken's. Any criterion that reads them
takes its tick_size tolerance from here.
A genuine AssetPairs recording is a Phase 7 item (operator ruling, 2026-09-18),
so that the candle criterion's tolerance stops being an invented number.
